fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner. Both CI failures were read from the failed first attempts. PR #513 (2026-11-13): leaf b's verifier exited 0 after writing Evidence but the runner judged 'verifier ended with neither Evidence nor findings' (a stale model read); change set 01M7942GRF (verifier-verdict-reads-fresh-model, PR #516) fixed that, and the read path has been rewritten since (#603, #606). PR #593 (2026-11-15 13:51 UTC): leaf a's Evidence commit was refused by update-ref ('cannot lock ref HEAD: is at ...') because the other leaf's builder committed on the shared run worktree's HEAD meanwhile; PR #595 (merged 17:39 UTC the same day) added commitOnly's HEAD-moved retry, covered by TestCommitOnlyHeadMoved. Reproduced at main f1c553613 by running the script 15 and then 20 times in sequence (capped scope, -p 2): one failure in each batch, a third symptom: leaf b's attempt-1 fake builder exited 1 because its git add hit 'Unable to create .../.git/worktrees/repo.built/index.lock: File exists', held by concurrent git work in the shared run worktree (the runner committing leaf a's Evidence). The fake bin/claude builder gives up on the first lock, where a real agent would retry. Planned: fix the fixture so the fake builder retries its add and commit while the index is locked; do not quarantine. Noticed only: the runner's own git calls on the real index (commitOnly's update-index after a successful update-ref) can lose the same lock to a builder's git, filed as a discovered-from draft change set.
